quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出测试数据上表现很差，这种过拟合需要被大幅减少 [p1]。

quote: there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly
claim: 作者指出，过拟合之所以发生，是因为存在许多几乎能完美建模训练集的权重设置，而每个这样的权重向量在测试数据上都会做出不同预测且几乎都比在训练数据上更差 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5
claim: 论文提出 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机将每个隐藏单元从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字数据集（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]；

quote: The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
claim: TIMIT 干净语音小词汇量识别基准，输入为 21 个相邻帧、每帧间隔 10ms，网络含 4 个 4000 单元的隐藏层和 185 个 softmax 输出单元 [p9]；

quote: These images were labeled by hand to produce 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images
claim: CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]；

quote: ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
claim: ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11]；

quote: We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures
claim: 对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者使用单独的验证集来选择架构，再用在验证集上表现最好的架构评估 dropout 在真实测试集上的性能 [p12]。

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 加每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，有 dropout 时提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误，在第六个隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，两层 2000 隐藏单元的前馈网络测试错误为 31.05%，使用 50% dropout 后降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型有更高训练误差，但实验表明现有求解器无法找到这样的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
claim: 该形式通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不增加额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射已足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含 1000 类，模型在 128 万训练图像上训练，在 5 万验证图像上评估 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 数据集上进行了更多研究，该数据集包含 5 万训练图像和 1 万测试图像，共 10 类 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 此外还在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，出现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]；

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
claim: 而 34 层 ResNet 优于 18 层 ResNet（提升 2.8%），且相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
claim: 而 34 层 ResNet 优于 18 层 ResNet（提升 2.8%），且相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升，1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1%
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升，1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相近，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 此外，作者指出深层普通网络优化困难的原因有待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 注意力机制已被广泛用于序列建模，但绝大多数情况下仍与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 作者因此提出 Transformer，完全摒弃循环、仅依赖注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖 [S1.p4]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络两个子层，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和 value [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]；

quote: $\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}(\frac{QK^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}})V$
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和 value [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]；

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
claim: 多头注意力将 query、key、value 线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力再拼接投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]，文中取 h=8、d_k=d_v=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads. For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
claim: 多头注意力将 query、key、value 线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力再拼接投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]，文中取 h=8、d_k=d_v=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化性，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，以及约 17M 句的半监督设置 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（包括集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新 state-of-the-art [S6.SS1.p1]；

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost
claim: 在英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于所有此前发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前最佳模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 消融实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，模型在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
claim: 作者指出，将注意力加权位置平均会降低有效分辨率，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输出位置周围大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms
claim: 作者还表示计划把 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频、视频等大规模输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的不足：它们难以访问和精确操作知识，性能落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策依据和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 已有结合参数与非参数记忆的模型（如 REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化 [S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化 [S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化 [S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.
claim: 作者提出两种形式：RAG-Sequence 对整条输出序列使用同一文档，RAG-Token 允许每个目标 token 使用不同文档 [S2.p2]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合微调检索器与生成器，不直接监督应检索哪个文档，且保持文档编码器与索引固定 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: Following and, we use the December 2018 dump. Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
claim: 所有实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，并用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: Following and, we use the December 2018 dump. Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时的 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
claim: RAG 在 NQ 上对答案不在任何检索文档中的情况达到 11.8% 准确率，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 BLEU 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，且两者在 Q-BLEU-1 上均优于 BART；人工评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更符合事实，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 三分类上，RAG 与最优流水线模型的差距在 4.3% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: RAG answers 70% correctly using the 2016 index for 2016 world leaders and 68% using the 2018 index for 2018 world leaders.
claim: 此外，通过替换非参数索引可更新世界知识，使用匹配年份索引时准确率约 70% 和 68%，不匹配时仅 12% 和 4% [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在故事生成等任务中检索组件可能“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务——抽取支持分类的维基百科句子——因 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试加入“空文档”机制但未发现性能提升，因此在简单性考虑下省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: However, a major limitation to this approach is that while the architecture is task-agnostic, there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调的范式虽然架构上与任务无关，但仍需要为每个任务准备数千到数十万条任务特定标注数据进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: By contrast, humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统仍难以做到这一点 [abstract]。

quote: By contrast, humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions
claim: 作者认为，扩大语言模型规模可能大幅提升与任务无关的少样本性能，因此通过训练 GPT-3 来检验这一假设 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, which we call GPT-3, and measuring its in-context learning abilities.
claim: 作者认为，扩大语言模型规模可能大幅提升与任务无关的少样本性能，因此通过训练 GPT-3 来检验这一假设 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters, with the last being the model we call GPT-3
claim: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大的称为 GPT-3，所有模型均训练了 3000 亿个 token [S2.SS1.p1][S2.T1]。

quote: All models were trained for a total of 300 billion tokens.
claim: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大的称为 GPT-3，所有模型均训练了 3000 亿个 token [S2.SS1.p1][S2.T1]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters, with the last being the model we call GPT-3
claim: GPT-3 沿用 GPT-2 的模型与架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密与局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
claim: 训练数据以 Common Crawl 为主，经过基于与高质量参考语料相似度的过滤和文档级模糊去重，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。

quote: we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
claim: 训练数据以 Common Crawl 为主，经过基于与高质量参考语料相似度的过滤和文档级模糊去重，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。

quote: For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
claim: 评估时模型不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: Few-Shot (FS) is the term we will use in this work to refer to the setting where the model is given a few demonstrations of the task at inference time as conditioning, but no weight updates are allowed.
claim: 评估时模型不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。

quote: we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
claim: 少样本设置中，从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受限于 2048 token 的上下文窗口 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
claim: 少样本设置中，从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受限于 2048 token 的上下文窗口 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks and tasks that are similar to language modeling
claim: 评估覆盖语言建模与完形填空、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 式任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE 和 NLI 等类别 [S3.p3]。

quote: First, we test GPT-3’s ability to perform arithmetic. Second, we create several tasks that involve rearranging or unscrambling the letters in a word
claim: 此外还设计了算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成、使用新词和纠正英语语法等合成与定性任务 [S3.SS9.p1]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: 在 NLP 任务上，GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与最先进的微调模型竞争甚至偶尔超越 [S1.p11]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: 例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上分别为 64.3%、68.0% 和 71.2% [S1.p11]。

quote: which include unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once
claim: GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术运算和仅见一次定义后使用新词 [S1.p12]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
claim: 同时，论文发现部分任务上少样本性能仍然不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: which include unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once
claim: 在新闻生成方面，人类评估者难以区分 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章与人类撰写的文章 [S1.p12]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如样本在文档层面语义重复、长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: GPT-3 在“常识物理”问题上似乎特别困难，并且在单样本甚至少样本设置下，在一些“比较”类任务（如 WiC 和 ANLI）以及部分阅读理解任务上仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 作者指出，由于只研究自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲某些任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。

quote: scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits, and augmentation with a different approach is likely to be necessary
claim: 此外，作者认为扩大任何类 LM 模型最终可能触及预训练目标的极限，因为当前目标对每个 token 等权且缺乏重要性概念，且模型未扎根于视频或真实物理交互等其他经验领域 [S5.p4]。

quote: Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
claim: 作者还承认预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是“从零学习”还是“识别已见任务”存在不确定性，以及大规模模型推理昂贵且不便 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
claim: 作者还承认预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是“从零学习”还是“识别已见任务”存在不确定性，以及大规模模型推理昂贵且不便 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on
claim: 作者还承认预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是“从零学习”还是“识别已见任务”存在不确定性，以及大规模模型推理昂贵且不便 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力近似 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力近似 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 作者指出，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换 CNN 的某些组件但保留整体结构，而纯注意力模型因使用专门注意力模式尚未在现代硬件上有效扩展 [S1.p2]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，希望以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 用于图像 [S1.p3]。

quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches $\mathbf{x}_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times(P^{2}\cdot C)}$
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为 \(N=HW/P^{2}\) 个 \(P\times P\) 的 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 与 BERT 类似，在序列前加入可学习的 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
claim: 位置信息通过标准可学习 1D 位置嵌入加入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
claim: 位置信息通过标准可学习 1D 位置嵌入加入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
claim: 微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化 \(D\times K\) 前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做 2D 插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型大小与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
claim: 基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型则把 CNN 特征图作为 ViT 输入 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$
claim: 训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

quote: these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 在中小数据集上，ViT 在 ImageNet 上比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，作者认为这可能是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。

quote: We find that large scale training trumps inductive bias.
claim: 但在更大数据集（14M–300M 图像）上，大规模训练胜过归纳偏置：ViT 在 ImageNet-21k 或 JFT-300M 预训练后接近或超过多个基准的最优结果，最佳模型达到 ImageNet 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 90.72%、CIFAR-100 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务 77.63% [S1.p5]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且所需计算资源显著更少；ViT-H/14 进一步提升，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
claim: 缩放研究中，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，约用 2–4 倍更少计算达到相同性能，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距随模型增大消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者承认仍有许多挑战：一是将 ViT 应用到检测、分割等其他视觉任务；二是继续探索自监督预训练方法，其初步实验显示自监督预训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。

quote: we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
claim: 此外，作者指出预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，还受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
claim: 在自监督部分，作者也说明其初步探索中 ViT-B/16 自监督预训练达到 79.9% ImageNet 准确率，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4%，并将对比式预训练留作未来工作 [S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答“林肯的生日是什么”这类问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（即作弊/数据污染），还是真正从维基百科等来源中学会了提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答“林肯的生日是什么”这类问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（即作弊/数据污染），还是真正从维基百科等来源中学会了提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种可能，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种可能，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个人物，每人六句、每句对应一个属性）以及由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并配套六类 QA 问题用于评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个人物，每人六句、每句对应一个属性）以及由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并配套六类 QA 问题用于评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个人物，每人六句、每句对应一个属性）以及由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并配套六类 QA 问题用于评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: For each individual, we pose six questions targeting their six unique attributes
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个人物，每人六句、每句对应一个属性）以及由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并配套六类 QA 问题用于评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data
claim: 训练流程包括两种：预训练+指令微调（先在 BIO 上预训练，再用一半人的 QA 微调，测试另一半人）和混合训练（同时用全部 BIO 与一半人的 QA 训练） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.

claim: 模型使用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种骨干架构，其中 M3GNet 用于快速零样本模拟，Graphormer 用于需要更高精度的任务 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: As of the date of publication, the training dataset contains $\sim$ 17M structures labeled with first-principles computations.
claim: 训练数据由平衡态和离平衡态探索器生成，覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa，截至发表包含约 1700 万个第一性原理标注结构 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: MPtrj-1k and Alexandria-1k are collected by sampling randomly one thousand materials from the MPtrj and Alexandria dataset, respectively.
claim: 零样本性能在多个数据集上评估，包括从 MPtrj 和 Alexandria 采样的近平衡数据集，以及为有限温度和压力条件创建的 MPF-Alkali-TP、MPF-TP 和 Random-TP 基准集 [S6.p1][S6.p2]。

quote: The MPF-Alkali-TP, MPF-TP, Random-TP benchmark sets are created with increasing complexity to evaluate the models’ performance on materials under finite temperature and pressure conditions with far from equilibrium atomic positions.
claim: 零样本性能在多个数据集上评估，包括从 MPtrj 和 Alexandria 采样的近平衡数据集，以及为有限温度和压力条件创建的 MPF-Alkali-TP、MPF-TP 和 Random-TP 基准集 [S6.p1][S6.p2]。

quote: MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 模型还在 MatBench Discovery 的 IS2RE 任务、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质数据集、自由能与相图计算，以及 118 个涵盖块体、MOF、二维材料、界面、分子晶体、聚合物和表面的分子动力学系统上进行了测试 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: Fig. 4 (a) shows the benchmark results on the materials from the PhononDB, using maximum phonon frequency as an indicator, and a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$.
claim: 模型还在 MatBench Discovery 的 IS2RE 任务、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质数据集、自由能与相图计算，以及 118 个涵盖块体、MOF、二维材料、界面、分子晶体、聚合物和表面的分子动力学系统上进行了测试 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: we randomly selected 118 systems including bulk inorganic materials, metal organic frameworks, two-dimensional materials, interfaces, molecular crystals, polymers and surfaces
claim: 模型还在 MatBench Discovery 的 IS2RE 任务、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质数据集、自由能与相图计算，以及 118 个涵盖块体、MOF、二维材料、界面、分子晶体、聚合物和表面的分子动力学系统上进行了测试 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: MatterSim’s capability to directly predict materials properties from structures is benchmarked on a few regression tasks from MatBench, including prediction of computed band gaps, shear moduli, dielectric constants, max phonon frequency of bulk crystalline materials, and the exfoliation energies of two-dimensional materials.
claim: 此外，在 MatBench 的六个结构到性质回归任务上评估了直接性质预测能力 [S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36 meV/atom (43 meV/atom as chemical accuracy) on MPF-TP
claim: MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的 MAE，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 在 MatBench Discovery 上取得 F1 分数 0.83 和 25 meV/atom 的形成能 MAE [S2.SS2.p2]。

quote: a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$
claim: 声子最大频率 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
claim: 声子最大频率 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: MatterSim achieves a sub- $10\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ error for temperatures up to $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ when compared with QHA computations at PBE level of theory
claim: 自由能预测与 PBE 计算相比在 1000 K 以下误差低于 10 meV/atom，与实验相比在 300–1000 K 范围 MAE 为 15 meV/atom [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: MatterSim achieved more than 90% success rate for all the material families tested, exhibiting robustness over wide temperature ranges.
claim: 在 118 个系统的分子动力学测试中，所有材料类别的成功率超过 90% [S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: with only 30 configurations sampled from an ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectory with rev-PBE0-D3 level of theory, MatterSim can be efficiently fine-tuned and the resultant model (indicated as finetune-30 model) reaches the same performance as the model trained from scratch with all 900 configurations
claim: 通过微调，仅需 30 个构型即可达到从头训练 900 个构型的性能，数据效率提升 30 倍 [S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前使用半局域原子相互作用描述，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相系统）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 数据覆盖方面，模型仅在同质块体系统上训练，未显式包含对催化等应用至关重要的表面和界面数据 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 模型目前仅原生支持 DFT-PBE 水平的推断，限制了其在涉及复杂相互作用（如聚合物和有机液体）系统中的应用 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 此外，模型目前仅支持能量、力和应力的原生预测，纳入电荷、自旋、磁矩等更多数据模态可能进一步提升精度和适用性 [S3.p3]。

quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
claim: 论文要探究不同神经网络模型的表示是否正在趋同，以及这种趋同是否有终点和驱动原则 [S1.p2][S1.p4]。

quote: different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe
claim: 论文要探究不同神经网络模型的表示是否正在趋同，以及这种趋同是否有终点和驱动原则 [S1.p2][S1.p4]。

quote: different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe
claim: 作者提出的核心假说是：不同模型都在试图得到对现实的表示，即对生成观测数据的世界事件联合分布的表示，因此随规模增大对齐会趋向一个收敛点 [S1.p4]。

quote: What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
claim: 作者还追问是什么导致了这种趋同、它是否会持续以及最终会止于何处 [S1.p3]。

quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
claim: 作者将表示定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似度结构）来刻画，把表示对齐定义为两个核之间相似度的度量 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
claim: 实验中作者采用互最近邻度量，即两个核各自 k 近邻集合的平均交集除以 k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。

quote: To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
claim: 跨模态对齐时，作者用成对数据集（如图像-标题数据）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核与文本核再测量其对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: Our contrastive learner tries to classify if a pair is positive or negative by learning a representation
claim: 理论上，作者在理想化世界设定下分析对比学习器，证明其最优解对应点互信息核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

quote: the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$
claim: 理论上，作者在理想化世界设定下分析对比学习器，证明其最优解对应点互信息核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

quote: We expand upon this observation by evaluating the transfer performance of $78$ vision models.
claim: 视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了 78 个视觉模型，涵盖不同架构、训练目标和数据集，并在 Places-365 验证集上用 k=10 近邻、1000 个图像表示计算对齐 [S2.SS2.p2][A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p3]。

quote: We consider 78 vision models in total
claim: 视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了 78 个视觉模型，涵盖不同架构、训练目标和数据集，并在 Places-365 验证集上用 k=10 近邻、1000 个图像表示计算对齐 [S2.SS2.p2][A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p3]。

quote: we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
claim: 视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了 78 个视觉模型，涵盖不同架构、训练目标和数据集，并在 Places-365 验证集上用 k=10 近邻、1000 个图像表示计算对齐 [S2.SS2.p2][A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p3]。

quote: we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
claim: 表示质量用 VTAB 的 19 个分类任务上的线性探测评估，并将训练与验证集下采样至最多 10,000 个样本 [A3.SS1.p2]。

quote: we use the Wikipedia captions dataset $\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i}$, composed of images from Wikipedia ( $x_{i}$) and their corresponding captions ( $y_{i}$)
claim: 跨模态方面，作者在 Wikipedia 标题数据集（WIT）上比较语言模型与视觉模型，使用 1024 个样本、k=10 近邻，语言模型族包括 BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA 等 [S2.SS3.p5][A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p3]。

quote: The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
claim: 跨模态方面，作者在 Wikipedia 标题数据集（WIT）上比较语言模型与视觉模型，使用 1024 个样本、k=10 近邻，语言模型族包括 BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA 等 [S2.SS3.p5][A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p3]。

quote: we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT
claim: 跨模态方面，作者在 Wikipedia 标题数据集（WIT）上比较语言模型与视觉模型，使用 1024 个样本、k=10 近邻，语言模型族包括 BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA 等 [S2.SS3.p5][A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
claim: 作者还做了颜色共现案例研究，以及用 LLaMA3-8B-Instruct 生成不同密度标题来检验信息量对对齐的影响 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: We vary caption length using the Densely-Captioned-Images (DCI) dataset.
claim: 作者还做了颜色共现案例研究，以及用 LLaMA3-8B-Instruct 生成不同密度标题来检验信息量对对齐的影响 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations
claim: 作者发现，在 78 个视觉模型中，迁移性能高的模型形成紧密聚集的表示，而性能弱的模型表示更分散 [S2.SS2.p2]。

quote: the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
claim: 跨模态上，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然 [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
claim: 对齐还与下游性能相关：与 DINOv2 对齐更好的 LLM 在 Hellaswag 和 GSM8K 上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。

quote: the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$
claim: 理论上，作者证明在理想化世界设定下，所考虑的对比学习器会收敛到同一个点互信息核，从而表示不同模态的成对统计 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: for any modality in our idealized world, we observe representational convergence to the same kernel, which represents certain pairwise statistics of $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$
claim: 理论上，作者证明在理想化世界设定下，所考虑的对比学习器会收敛到同一个点互信息核，从而表示不同模态的成对统计 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation
claim: 颜色案例研究显示，从图像共现或语言共现学到的颜色表示大致恢复相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
claim: 作者承认，其数学论证只严格适用于 Z 的双射投影，对于有损或随机的观测函数并不成立，因此不同模态可能包含不同信息 [S6.SS0.Px1.p2]。

quote: we have yet to see the same level of convergence across all domains
claim: 作者指出目前主要关注视觉和语言两种模态，尚未在所有领域看到同等程度的趋同，例如机器人领域还没有标准化的世界状态表示方式 [S6.SS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
claim: 作者还提到，研究者的偏见和 AI 社区的集体偏好可能塑造了模型发展轨迹，导致趋同于类人表示 [S6.SS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
claim: 此外，作者承认其论证只适用于被优化以在众多任务上表现良好的智能系统，专用智能可能不会趋同 [S6.SS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment
claim: 作者也指出对齐度量本身存在争议，且实验中对齐分数只达到 0.16（理论上限为 1），这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS0.Px5.p1][S6.SS0.Px6.p1]。

quote: alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric
claim: 作者也指出对齐度量本身存在争议，且实验中对齐分数只达到 0.16（理论上限为 1），这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS0.Px5.p1][S6.SS0.Px6.p1]。

quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：LM 智能体在更复杂的软件工程任务上尚未被充分探索，而现有界面（如 Linux shell）是为人类用户设计的，LM 智能体作为一类新的终端用户可能有不同需求，因此需要研究界面设计如何影响 LM 智能体的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：LM 智能体在更复杂的软件工程任务上尚未被充分探索，而现有界面（如 Linux shell）是为人类用户设计的，LM 智能体作为一类新的终端用户可能有不同需求，因此需要研究界面设计如何影响 LM 智能体的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
claim: 作者指出，LM 智能体直接与 Linux shell 交互时难以可靠地采取行动，例如无法提供编辑小段文件的简单命令，且无效编辑没有反馈，这些缺陷严重妨碍性能，从而促使设计 ACI [S1.p2]。

quote: SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的智能体，其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，使用护栏防止常见错误，并在每一步给出具体简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。

quote: The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，智能体每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，再纳入命令执行反馈 [S3.p1]。

quote: we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance
claim: 设计方法上，作者假设 LM 固定，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查智能体行为发现问题并提出改进，以及网格搜索选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 实验主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上进行，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 的 300 个实例上进行，另外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。

quote: All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
claim: 所有结果、消融和分析基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。

quote: The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines
claim: 对比基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）基线和基于 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 基线 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework
claim: 对比基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）基线和基于 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 基线 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric
claim: 主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 推理成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: SWE-agent 搭配 GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最好，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: 相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
claim: 在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 率 [S5.p2]。

quote: leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
claim: 消融显示，没有搜索工具时性能为 15.7%，迭代搜索反而降至 12.0%；没有文件编辑器时降至 10.3%；没有 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 消融显示，没有搜索工具时性能为 15.7%，迭代搜索反而降至 12.0%；没有文件编辑器时降至 10.3%；没有 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).

claim: 模型采用低红移类星体复合 SED 作为入射通量，并假设 A_V=3 mag，在 z=4 到 z=7 范围内计算 SED，与 JWST NIRCam 各宽带滤光片的 5σ 点源深度比较 [S2.p4][S2.p9]。

quote: For the cases with $n_{0}=10$ and $100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the SED shapes from the optical band to $\lambda=2-3~\mu{\rm m}$ agree to the observed spectra of LRDs

quote: the density range is approximated as $10^{2.9\gamma+0.83}\lesssim n_{0}/({\rm cm}^{-3})\lesssim 10^{3},$ (5) which is valid $\gamma<0.8$.
These results agree well to the mean value of the dust mass $\langle M_{\rm dust}\rangle\simeq 1.6^{+4.8}_{-0.9}\times 10^{4}~M_{\odot}$ estimated using NIRCam images of LRDs.
claim: 此外，模型估计的尘埃质量与 NIRCam 图像估计值相符 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并在广泛任务上达到与领先语言模型相当的质量 [S1.p3][S1.p6]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并在广泛任务上达到与领先语言模型相当的质量 [S1.p3][S1.p6]。

quote: We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.
claim: 作者认为开发高质量基础模型有三个关键杠杆：数据、规模和管理复杂性，并试图在开发过程中优化这三者 [S1.p4]。

quote: We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.
claim: 此外，论文还探索通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中 [S2.p4]。

quote: We make a few small modifications compared to Llama 2:
claim: Llama 3 采用标准稠密 Transformer 架构，相比 Llama 2 仅有少量修改，包括使用分组查询注意力、文档注意力掩码、128K 词表和更高的 RoPE 基频 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: We highlight special efforts to improve performance for specific capabilities such as code (Section 4.3.1), multilinguality (Section 4.3.2), math and reasoning (Section 4.3.3), long context (Section 4.3.4), tool use (Section 4.3.5), factuality (Section 4.3.6), and steerability (Section 4.3.7).
claim: 后训练采用监督微调、拒绝采样和直接偏好优化的多轮流程，并针对代码、多语言、数学推理、长上下文、工具使用、事实性和可控性等能力进行专门数据策划 [S4.p1][S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: 1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?
claim: 重复采样的有效性取决于两个关键属性：覆盖率（随样本数增加能解决多少问题）和精确率（能否从样本集合中识别正确样本）[S1.p5]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，以正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，然后使用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试）从样本中选择最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
claim: 覆盖率定义为至少一个生成样本能解决的问题比例，在编码任务中等价于 pass@k 指标，并使用无偏估计公式计算 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: pass@k $\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\text{\# of problems}}\sum_{i=1}^{\text{\# of problems}}\left(1-\frac{\binom{N-C_{i}}{k}}{\binom{N}{k}}\right)$
claim: 覆盖率定义为至少一个生成样本能解决的问题比例，在编码任务中等价于 pass@k 指标，并使用无偏估计公式计算 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: 1. Majority Vote: We pick the most common final answer. 2. Reward Model + Best-of-N: We use a reward model to score each solution, and pick the answer from the highest-scoring sample. 3. Reward Model + Majority Vote: We calculate a majority vote where each sample is weighted by its reward model score.
claim: 对于没有自动验证器的任务，论文测试了多数投票、奖励模型最佳选择（Best-of-N）和奖励模型加权多数投票三种验证方法 [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: 1. GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set. 2. MATH: Another dataset of math word problems that are generally harder than those from GSM8K. Similarly, we evaluate on 128 random problems from this dataset’s test set. 3. MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset. 4. CodeContests: A dataset of competitive programming problems. Each problem has a text description, along with a set of input-output test cases (hidden from the model) that can be used to verify the correctness of a candidate solution. We enforce that models write their solutions using Python3. 5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
claim: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 数学应用题（各 128 个随机测试问题）、MiniF2F-MATH 形式化证明（130 个问题）、CodeContests 竞赛编程（140 个问题）和 SWE-bench Lite 真实 GitHub 问题 [S2.p4]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.
claim: 原文指出，现有 CoT 提示和基于人工标注推理轨迹的后训练方法依赖人工标注，限制可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类示例，无法探索更优的非人类式推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework.

quote: Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards.
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks.
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: we develop DeepSeek-R1, whose pipeline is illustrated in Figure 2.

claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段流程：冷启动数据、RL、拒绝采样与 SFT、二次 RL，并引入语言一致性奖励和基于模型的通用奖励 [S3.p2][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准使用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；在 MATH500 达到 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；在 AMC23 达到 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；在 CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3% 对基座 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，超过 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者指出，维持有效性能所需的最小样本量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提到未来工作可以探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: In this iteration of Qwen2.5-VL, we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: 论文旨在探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知差以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: The model is initialized with pre-trained weights from the Qwen2.5 LLM.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: we first group spatially adjacent sets of four patch features. These grouped features are then concatenated and passed through a two-layer multi-layer perceptron (MLP)
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: our model directly uses the actual dimensions of the input image to represent bounding boxes, points, and other spatial features.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，直接使用输入图像实际尺寸表示边界框和点 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2]；

quote: we introduce a novel and efficient strategy that aligns MRoPE IDs directly with the timestamps.
claim: 在时间上引入动态帧率训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE ID 直接与时间戳对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等最先进模型进行对比 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated our models across a diverse range of OCR, chart, and document understanding benchmarks.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL’s grounding capabilities on the referring expression comprehension benchmarks, object detection in the wild, self-curated point grounding benchmark, and CountBench.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assessed our models across a diverse range of video understanding and grounding tasks, utilizing benchmarks that include videos ranging from a few seconds to several hours in length.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assess the agent capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL through various aspects.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.
claim: 视频评估中，每个视频分析的最大帧数上限为 768，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU. For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models and achieving performance comparable to GPT-4o.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在 MathVista 上取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最先进分数 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
claim: 在文档与 OCR 综合基准 OCRBench_v2 上，Qwen2.5-VL 在英文和中文赛道分别大幅超过最佳模型 Gemini 1.5-Pro 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: On the Charades-STA dataset, which assesses the capability to accurately localize events or activities with precise timestamps, Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在视频定位数据集 Charades-STA 上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU 分数，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: notably setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).
claim: 在 GUI 基准 ScreenSpot Pro 上取得 43.6% 准确率，远超 Aguvis-72B 的 23.6% 和 Qwen2-VL-72B 的 1.6% [S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 作者指出，在将 CoT 推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管开发了基于规则和模型驱动的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤的准确性，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。
